title: Independent semantic scopes
finding: One complete concept per search scope; build breadth first, ordered rounds, update structure on discoveries, map results to nodes, evidence and relations; stop only on practical saturation.

title: Operational handoff
finding: Preserve project identity, authority precedence, source-reading order, exact state, failures, dependencies, evidence derivation chain and next action. Block unresolved authority conflict.

title: Structured search visualization
finding: Master overview and local group frames; parent-to-direct-child links; preserve nesting, readability and zero collision across zoom levels. Geometry follows semantics.

title: Evidence navigation
finding: Claim to evidence ID to exact source location. Prefer verified web text fragment, or precise page/section/timestamp/clause/line fallback; don't infer from titles.

title: Language and learner prompts
finding: Historical Forest language contract: Egyptian Arabic, second-person imperative, Arabic-first technical terminology with bold parenthesized English. Not automatically current REF language rules.

title: Concrete re-audit and correction
finding: Source stability, universal subset overstatement, overbroad evidence ranges, malformed links, security/communications merger and mixed-script rendering defects found and corrected. Final render check and independent review not claimed.
